mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (event_id, type, channel, recipient, subject, body, store_id) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{type}, #{channel}, #{recipient}, #{subject}, #{body}, #{storeId}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET status = 'SENT', attempts = attempts + 1, sent_at = now(), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notifications SET attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{error}, status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notifications SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
